case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests consistently praised the hotel's central location, friendly staff, clean comfortable rooms and comprehensive breakfast offerings; several reviews also noted quiet, well-insulated rooms and good amenities (comfortable beds, electric blinds, toiletries). A few guests reported negative or mixed experiences, including isolated comments about unfriendly or less friendly reception staff, afternoon housekeeping delays, traffic noise for street-facing rooms, and limited fresh orange juice/coffee options.
